first_appearance_definition: The first visible portion within the clip that is identifiable and can be temporally matched to that subject; frame numbering starts at 0.

entities.name: stack of brown cardboard boxes
entities.identification: Brown cardboard boxes stacked vertically at the image-left edge, with dark text, barcodes, and handling marks on the box surfaces.

entities.name: group of white product shelves
entities.identification: White multi-tier shelves inside the store and an endcap shelf facing the entrance.

entities.name: colorfully packaged product display
entities.identification: Densely arranged rows of products in blue, green, red, orange, and other colorful packaging on the central shelves.

entities.name: black open-top product display cabinet
entities.identification: A group of low, black, rectangular open-top cabinets containing packaged products with blue-and-white graphics and text.

entities.name: white grid-patterned suspended ceiling
entities.identification: The suspended ceiling above the store, formed by continuously joined light whitish panels with seams forming a regular grid.

entities.name: cyan-and-white hanging sign
entities.identification: Multiple rectangular hanging signs above the store interior, with cyan upper sections and white lower sections.

entities.name: blue-and-white wall-side display cabinet
entities.identification: Multi-tier tall cabinets arranged along the image-left wall, with light whitish outer frames, cyan-and-white top edges, and dark blue bases.

entities.name: store interior light gray floor
entities.identification: The light gray, level floor with soft reflections between the display fixtures inside the store.

entities.name: rear black wall
entities.identification: A large, nearly black background wall at the rear right of the store, with light-colored rectangular panels in its upper section.

entities.name: white-cup product display
entities.identification: Rows of white cup-shaped products on an endcap shelf, with red lid rims and red-and-gray printed patterns.

entities.name: portrait-packaged product display
entities.identification: White-background rectangular packages on the display shelves at the rear right, with repeated portraits of people with dark or red hair on the fronts.

entities.name: black-bordered doorway
entities.identification: A rectangular opening connecting the storage-room side to the brightly lit store, with a dark upper frame and side frames.

entities.name: storage room grayish-white wall
entities.identification: The vertical grayish-white wall section between the cardboard boxes and the black-bordered doorway, with broad light and dark patches covering its surface.

entities.name: storage room dark gray flat ceiling
entities.identification: The narrow strip of dim gray ceiling surface exposed above the black-bordered doorway.

entities.name: recessed rectangular light panel
entities.identification: Multiple rectangular light panels within the store's grid-patterned suspended ceiling, with dark borders and emitting bright white light.

entities.name: store entrance light-colored door panel
entities.identification: The open, light beige-gray flat-panel door on the right side of the doorway, with a small round handle visible near its lower part.
